item.title: Music publishers sue Anthropic over alleged copyright theft
item.description: Major music publishers filed a lawsuit against Anthropic, accusing it of large-scale unauthorized use of copyrighted songs.

item.title: Next grocery price surge expected in US
item.description: So far, US grocery inflation has hit certain items like beef, coffee, and chocolate hardest. Now, broader price increases may be on the way.

item.title: Google Maps shows 'Lake America' as Canada likens change to SNL sketch
item.description: President Trump's directive to rename Lake Ontario to 'Lake America' has sparked debate, with tech firms deciding whether to adopt the change.

item.title: CIA chief Ratcliffe proposed Trump-Putin-Zelensky summit in Moscow
item.description: During a visit to Moscow, CIA Director John Ratcliffe suggested a trilateral meeting involving Trump, Putin, and Zelensky, according to sources.
